subject: ddl,expression: introduce `CtxWithHandleTruncateErrLevel` to wrap a expression context to handle truncate error (#53441)
summary: Reviewed diff vs first parent for expression/planner only. New `CtxWithHandleTruncateErrLevel` wraps `BuildContext` by overriding `EvalContext.TypeCtx()` flags (`TruncateAsWarning`/`IgnoreTruncateErr`) and `ErrCtx()` truncate-group level without mutating session `StmtCtx` state; call sites in `pkg/expression/expression.go` and `pkg/planner/core/logical_plan_builder.go` use it to ignore truncation warnings/errors in narrow evaluation scopes. No Blocker/High correctness or SQL-semantics issues found; upstream/master retains the same logic (moved to `pkg/expression/exprctx/context.go`) with no later fix indicating latent breakage.
